Agent Name: Planner
Step Number: 2
Reason for Mistake: The Planner mistakenly shifted the likely answer to Norris Bradbury, conflating Bradbury’s postwar leadership at Los Alamos with the wartime scientific directorship of the project that developed the first atomic bomb. This reflects a role/timeline misinterpretation; J. Robert Oppenheimer directed the Los Alamos laboratory during the Manhattan Project, which aligns with Feynman’s Water Boiler work at the same site.
